title: Server-side siteverify with the always-pass secret returns success true and the handler proceeds with 200
asA: shelf consumer whose Worker verifies every Turnstile token server-side
iWant: a POST to https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify with the pinned always-pass secret (1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA) and any response token to return success:true and the handler to respond 200
soThat: the verified path is exercised end-to-end against the live Cloudflare endpoint on every gate run

acceptanceCriteria.description: A live POST to https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify with secret=1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA and any response token returns success:true; the pack-fixture /api/submit handler proceeds with 200 and the shipped Node probe siteverify-fixture asserts success:true.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture running on 127.0.0.1 on a free port with the pinned always-pass secret in the environment
acceptanceCriteria.when: a submit hits /api/submit with any response token
acceptanceCriteria.then: the server-side POST to siteverify returns success:true and the handler responds 200

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the pack fixture with an empty TURNSTILE_SITEKEY in the environment, when the applying project boots, the widget mount refuses to render with a stable turnstile.sitekey-missing error and no submit surface is reachable until the sitekey is set.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture running with TURNSTILE_SITEKEY unset or empty
acceptanceCriteria.when: the applying project boots and a client loads a guarded surface
acceptanceCriteria.then: the widget mount refuses to render, the guarded surface returns 503 with body {"errorCode":"turnstile.sitekey-missing"} and no downstream handler runs

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the pack fixture with an empty TURNSTILE_SECRET in the environment, when the verifier is constructed at boot, createTurnstileVerifier refuses with a stable turnstile.secret-missing error before any siteverify traffic can fire.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture running with TURNSTILE_SECRET unset or empty
acceptanceCriteria.when: the verifier factory runs at boot and no downstream handler is registered
acceptanceCriteria.then: createTurnstileVerifier throws {code:"turnstile.secret-missing"} and no siteverify network call is issued

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the pack fixture with only one of the pair present (TURNSTILE_SITEKEY set and TURNSTILE_SECRET unset, or vice versa), when boot runs, the config refuses with a stable turnstile.pair-incomplete error naming which half is missing.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture running with exactly one of the sitekey/secret pair set
acceptanceCriteria.when: boot runs and the elicited pair is inspected
acceptanceCriteria.then: boot refuses with {code:"turnstile.pair-incomplete", missing:"sitekey"|"secret"} and no verifier or widget mount initialises
